Description: Sale of welding equipment, safety gear. Filling, sale and distribution of cylinderized medical and industrial gases. Operating as Alliance Welding since 2009, and merged into Airgas in 2019, the primary operations at 1224 & 1230 Sixth Street include the filling, sale and distribution of cylinderized industrial and medical gases, servicing customers in the Life Science and Healthcare, Met-Fab, Food and Beverage, and Construction industries. Current customers include UC Berkeley, Chevron Refinery, Bayer Pharmaceuticals, Berkeley Forge, Alta Bates Hospital, Terminal Manufacturing, and USDA. Incidental retail sales include welding supplies and safety gear.
